title: Plumeform dark closing card
description: A rounded near-black green card with a soft teal glow (a slot for art) floating in a pale mint band: tracked eyebrow, a big centred extra-bold heading, a paper pill button beside an underlined link, and a short note. Rises in as it scrolls into view; the backdrop fades up.
notes: the card forces dark colours; the band around it uses accent
